verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer ships client-facing tech platforms such as the Contract Generator, GDHQ, the D&O portal and Catalyze, so it is fair to ask whether its tooling offers autonomous background automations. None of the evidence shows schedulable, autonomous, or background automations: ChatGD is an internal, interactive document-query chat for attorneys, and the client tools are self-service forms and generators. Probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec.
